# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Sends Seth for the Oil of Mercy

---

**17:1** Adam called Seth to him and said: 'My son Seth, go quickly to paradise, you and your mother Eve, and bring me a little of the oil of mercy from the tree of mercy, that I may be anointed and have relief from this pain.'

**17:2** Seth said to his father: 'Father, I do not know the way to paradise. I have not seen the way since we were expelled.'

**17:3** Adam said to him: 'Go to the east of paradise and you will find the footprints of your mother and me, for we walked there together. Follow our footprints and you will find the gate.'

**17:4** Seth rose and took his mother Eve by the hand and set off toward paradise.

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
